Fastino GLiDE vs. Fastino GLiGuard-LLMGuardrails-300M vs. Fastino POC model vs. Fastino GLiNER2.5-Decide

Source snapshot (UTC): 2026-11-04T15:53:58.346198+00:00

Reference only: each model uses its own successful samples; these are not sample-aligned rankings. GLiDE uses Noul scores; GLiGuard uses direct unsafe confidence from independent safe/unsafe scores. The POC model uses the unsafe choice probability, not choice confidence. Its latency is the successful-request CSV mean, not log elapsed/processed. GLiNER2.5-Decide uses direct unsafe label confidence and successful-request CSV latency; failed and overlength requests are excluded from quality metrics. Timing protocols differ and include network overhead and failure waits.

PII = binary detection: present vs absent.Not entity extraction or masking quality. PII datasets contain positives only; AUROC is undefined. GLiGuard was not tested on PII; its PII results are N/A. The POC model was also not tested on PII; its PII results are N/A. GLiNER2.5-Decide was not tested on PII; its PII results are N/A.
